subject.title: ci: remove redundant cli github release workflow

question: Should ClawHub retain the standalone CLI GitHub Release repair workflow, replace it with a release-only mode, or intentionally retire that recovery path?
rationale: The PR removes a privileged operational fallback, and automation cannot safely choose whether losing post-publish release repair is acceptable for maintainers.

options.title: Replace Before Deletion
options.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that works after npm has already accepted the package, then update docs and tests.

options.title: Keep The Existing Workflow
options.body: Leave the standalone workflow and runbook in place until release owners decide the post-publish repair path is no longer needed.

options.title: Retire With Owner Acceptance
options.body: Accept the operational tradeoff only if release/security automation owners document how maintainers should recover a failed GitHub Release after npm publish.

recommendation.title: Replace Before Deletion
recommendation.body: Add a tested release-only repair mode or equivalent workflow path that works after npm has already accepted the package, then update docs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS explicitly routes workflow and deploy-spec ownership to this group, and the decision is release/security automation policy rather than a local code defect only.
